fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/jimmy-joe-campground ('No fees are required for this site', 'Free'; page last updated May 5, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: May fill on summer weekends and holidays; the Forest Service advises arriving by early afternoon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/jimmy-joe-campground ('This campground does not use a reservation system; it is managed on a first-come, first-served basis... arrive in the early afternoon... There is a 16 day stay limit.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open year-round. Full services Memorial Day – Labor Day. Reduced services in shoulder season.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/jimmy-joe-campground ('Camp sites: 10'; 'Individual camp sites vary in size, but the max trailer length is 30ft.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Some sites have bear-resistant food storage lockers. No trash pickup, no firewood, no host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/jimmy-joe-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Some sites in campground have bear resistant food storage lockers.'; 'Host : No'; 'Trash Pickup: No'; 'Firewood: No'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD), on the banks of East Rosebud Creek in the scenic East Rosebud drainage, ~9 mi south of Roscoe on East Rosebud Rd (20 mi west of Red Lodge via MT 78). Trailheads nearby: East Rosebud (#15), Spread Creek (#13), Phantom Creek (#17). --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 5, 2026) confirms free, FCFS (no reservation system), 16-day limit, 10 sites, 30-ft max trailer, vault toilets, no potable water; added season year-round (full services Memorial Day-Labor Day). Hookups (derived none) left; page silent. No alert for the campground or East Rosebud Rd.
